options.name: audit_logs_retention
options.description: Audit logs retention in days

options.name: critical_value
options.description: Maps CRITICAL severity to a different value. Default: CRITICAL

options.name: disable_actions
options.description: Set to true to disable default actions for events.

options.name: email_recipients
options.description:
Default email recipients. These recipients receive notifications of all alarms except those triggered by events
that have a different list of email recipients specified in the event definition or for which actions are
disabled.

options.name: email_sender
options.description: Global for all alarm notification emails, the sender email that appears in the emails.

options.name: email_subject
options.description:
Optional and global email subject for all alarm notification emails. Leave blank to send alarm info in the
subject.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Enabled

options.name: id
options.description: Resource ID for direct lookup. Mutually exclusive with name-based identification.

options.name: info_value
options.description: Maps INFO severity to a different severity value. Default: INFO

options.name: major_value
options.description: Maps MAJOR severity to a different severity value. Default: MAJOR

options.name: minor_value
options.description: Maps MINOR severity to a different severity value. Default: MINOR

options.name: quota_email_hourly_limit
options.description: Maximum quota alert emails VMS will send per hour

options.name: quota_email_interval
options.description: The minimal interval time between quota alert emails sent to a user.

options.name: quota_email_provider
options.description:
Specify which query context should be used to query providers for user quota alert emails. 'Aggregated' will
perform an aggregated query of all providers. Alternatively, you can specify a specific provider if connected to
the cluster.

options.name: quota_email_suffix
options.description:
A default suffix to add to append to user names to form an email address. This is used as the email recipient
address for sending a user user quota alert emails. It is only used if an email address is not found for the user
on a provider.

options.name: smtp_host
options.description: SMTP server host name for alert emails.

options.name: smtp_password
options.description: Password for SMTP authentication

options.name: smtp_port
options.description: The port used by the SMTP server to send outgoing emails.

options.name: smtp_use_tls
options.description: Set to true to send email over a TLS connection.

options.name: smtp_user
options.description: User for SMTP authentication

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the resource (absent is not supported).

options.name: syslog_host
options.description: The syslog server's IP address, for sending event logs to a syslog server.

options.name: syslog_ipmi_audit
options.description: CNode and DNode IPMI commands

options.name: syslog_port
options.description: The port number used by the syslog server to listen on for syslog requests.

options.name: syslog_protocol
options.description: The protocol used for communicating with the remote syslog server.

options.name: syslog_secure_audit
options.description: /var/log/secure logs audit Requires VMS 5.5 or later.

options.name: syslog_shell_audit
options.description: CNode and DNode shell commands

options.name: syslog_vms_audit
options.description: VMS audit

options.name: vms
options.description: VAST VMS connection parameters.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for async operations to complete.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for async operations.
